cohort: Women who delivered during the period of 2019-2021 in South India, as captured by the National Family Health Survey.
finding: The study identified significant regional disparities in C-section utilization in South India, with maternal age, educational attainment, healthcare facility type, child size at birth, ever pregnancy termination, wealth index, and urban residence identified as key determinants.
mod_finding: This research, focused on mode of birth (C-section), revealed complex patterns and socio-economic influences on C-section deliveries, including significant regional disparities and various identified maternal and demographic determinants.
